text:
Maya: Quick scope post — we need a razor-focused MVP to make ship by the target window. Proposing a 'slim' MVP: remove tenant-level analytics, defer prompt-store UX (read-only placeholder only), keep core prediction API + embeddings cache. Thoughts?

Alex: 👍 Removing tenant analytics buys a lot. Rough ask: how much infra/infra-ops work are we dropping vs leaving as a stub?

Maya: Ballpark: analytics full landing ~3 dev-weeks infra + 2 dev-weeks backend, prompt-store UX ~2 dev-weeks, polish ~1w. So cutting analytics + full prompt UX frees ~5w. That should let us keep the API+embcache work and still hit the window if we do parallel QA.

Riley: From design: prompt-store read-only placeholder + basic search box is fine for MVP. We can ship without item-level history or fancy UX. Recommend deprioritizing animations and non-critical microcopy. :+1:

Nora: Operational note: if we cut analytics now, ensure schema compatibility so v1 can land without a migration. Add a shim table and a feature-flag so writes can be turned on later. Also need to confirm SLOs — removing analytics won't reduce inference latency but changes storage/cost surface.

Alex: Implementation approach: land feature-flag for analytics writes (default off), implement minimal storage shim, and ship core API. For embeddings cache optimization, put behind a rollout flag and canary (10% traffic) — reduces cost risk.

Maya: Decision summary (agreed):
- MVP scope: core prediction API, embeddings cache (canary), slim console (placeholder prompt-store, no tenant analytics), basic telemetry.
- v1 scope: tenant analytics, full prompt-store UX, dashboard polish.
- Timeline: request a 1-week slide to allow canary + hardening.

Riley: OK to compress design tasks into a single minimal modal + docs. I can deliver assets in 3 working days.

Nora: I'll add the schema shim + monitoring hooks. Also will prepare a rollback playbook for the analytics flag.

Alex: I'll own the feature flag + canary rollout for both analytics and emb cache. Est. two sprints to instrument and safety-test.

Maya: Action items / owners: Alex -> feature flags & canary; Riley -> minimal prompt modal; Nora -> schema shim + monitoring; Maya -> update roadmap + stakeholder note. Daily sync for this slice until ship.

Maya: I'll post an updated milestone in the roadmap doc and ping sales/support about scope change.

DeployBot: CI queued for branch slim-mvp — build #657 started.

Alex: thanks — will comment PR with rollout plan and the flag names (analytics_enable, embcache_ramp).

Maya: Great. If anything blocks, tag me @Maya.
